Maya (PM): Quick post-launch sync — propose we pick the iteration split for the next 2 weeks: bugs vs enhancements. ACME search latency regression (CS#1423) and a few smaller UX asks on the backlog. Thoughts?
Jason (Eng): Can we get an inventory? I have ~12 dev-days available this sprint after infra work.
Priya (SRE): ACME issue looks like cache invalidation + a GC spike. I can take ops lead, low-risk fix if we can reproduce at scale.
Tom (Design): UX asks include a microflow tweak and copy changes — ~2 designer days total.
Ana (CS): ACME wants a timeframe; they flagged this as blocking their rep demo next week.
Maya (PM): Options: A) Bug-first (70%): focus ACME + top 4 regressions. B) Balanced (50/50): ACME + 2 small enhancements. C) Feature-first (30% bug): ship 3 small marketing features.
Jason (Eng): Feature-first feels risky given regressions. Balanced is doable if we hard-scope enhancements.
Priya (SRE): For ACME we need a canary plan + runbook. I can draft the runbook and the `smoke` checks.
Maya (PM): Proposed acceptance criteria for ACME fix:
- 99p latency < 200ms in staging under ACME-like load
- No error-rate regression vs current baseline
- Canary rollout at 10% traffic for 24h with automated rollback trigger
Jason (Eng): Add an e2e CI test: `test/search_regression_test.py::test_acme_scenario` and a perf artifact upload to the build.
Maya (PM): If we go Balanced, owners: ACME fix -> Priya + Jason, UX polish -> Tom, Enhancement #2 (embedding cache hinting) -> Jason, Backlog grooming + release notes -> Maya.
Ana (CS): I'll notify ACME with proposed timeline and set expectation for partial mitigation first.
DevBot (bot): Canary slot reserved: `2026-03-29 09:00-11:00 UTC` by request from @Priya.
Tom (Design): I'll drop mocks in the sprint ticket and block copy with @Ana for tone.
Jason (Eng): I'll open the sprint PR with tasks and point estimates tonight.
Maya (PM): Decision: Balanced (50/50) — scope locked pending any objections by 15:00 UTC today. Action items: Priya to draft runbook (EOD), Jason to add CI test + tasks, Tom to attach mocks, Maya to update board and create triage doc.
Ana (CS): Confirmed — informing ACME and asking for any acceptance test data.
Jason (Eng): One ask: keep enhancement scope to <3 dev-days each.
Maya (PM): Noted. If no objections by 15:00 — locking scope. :thumbsup:
Priya (SRE): I'll ping infra to reserve the canary infra and start the runbook draft now.
DevBot (bot): Reminder posted to #build-failures three hours before canary window.
Maya (PM): Thanks all — follow-up doc link will be in the thread once I create it.
